title: Light and Malt Japanese Rice Donburi
description: A paleo-friendly, light Japanese dish originating from Shikoku featuring dill pickles and a delicate flavor profile. Perfect for a sick day or a simple weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the gochujang and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and white pepper, and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dill pickle slices and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly caramelized.
Add the cooked Japanese short-grain rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Season the rice with malt vinegar and stir-fry for an additional minute.
Transfer the rice mixture to a bamboo tray and garnish with chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds.
Deglaze the skillet with a small amount of water and pour the sauce over the Donburi.
